values.note: City of Jacksonville: RV camping $30.00 per day plus tax; tent $18.00; cozy cabins $30.00 (two-day minimum). Payments final and non-refundable. Park entry $5 per car (up to six people), military/veterans half off admission.

fees.source: https://www.jacksonville.gov/departments/parks-and-recreation/jaxparks/oceanfront-parks/kathryn-abbey-hanna-park/camping-at-hanna-park ('RV camping - 30.00, per day, plus tax'; 'Tent camping - 18.00 per day') + the park page (Fees: '$5 per car (up to six people)'), read 2026-10-21 (page (c) 2026)

values.note: 300 sites (RV, tent and rustic cabins) in a wooded area on paved roads. Occupancy limit six persons per site.

sites.source: https://www.jacksonville.gov/departments/parks-and-recreation/jaxparks/oceanfront-parks/kathryn-abbey-hanna-park/camping-at-hanna-park ('The campground at Hanna Park includes 300 sites set in a wooded area that is easily accessible by paved roads. RV, tent and rustic cabin camping are available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Coin-operated laundry; camp store and concession run by Adventure Kayak Florida (firewood, ice, kayak and bike rentals). Overnight security.

facilities.source: https://www.jacksonville.gov/departments/parks-and-recreation/jaxparks/oceanfront-parks/kathryn-abbey-hanna-park/camping-at-hanna-park ('Dump station', 'Restroom facilities with showers', 'Camp Store', 'Coin operated laundry') + the park page ('Campground Store and Concession managed by Adventure Kayak Florida'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked online on the city's WebTrac reservation system (debit/credit card). The city's page also says 'Reservations for all sites are first-come, first-served.' RV campers may stay up to 30 nights within a 45-day period (tents 14). Payments final and non-refundable.

booking.source: https://www.jacksonville.gov/departments/parks-and-recreation/jaxparks/oceanfront-parks/kathryn-abbey-hanna-park/camping-at-hanna-park ('Hanna Park has implemented a new camping reservation system which will allow booking of campsites using debit or credit cards'; 'RV Campers may stay up to 30 nights within a 45 day period'), read 2026-10-21

summary: First check of this entry against the City of Jacksonville's pages: added $30 RV rate (tent $18), water hookups (electric amperage not stated), 300 sites, showers/dump/laundry/camp store, online WebTrac booking and the 30-nights-in-45 RV limit. The city's 'first-come, first-served' wording beside an online reservation system was kept in booking.note rather than read as an fcfs value. Not stated: amperage, sewer, site lengths, season.
